subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as the public maintainer policy notice, or should maintainers retire it now that the cap is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and enforced by automation?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 already carry the policy, but a maintainer later renamed, pinned, and reopened the issue, so automation cannot safely infer whether the pinned notice is still intended.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
options.body: Leave the issue open and locked as the visible policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the durable contributor guide.

options.title: Retire The Notice
options.body: Close the issue with a short pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md if maintainers no longer want a pinned GitHub announcement.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and locked as the visible policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the durable contributor guide.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the latest human rename, pin, and reopen decisions on this policy notice.
